positionLabel: Boyd, one quarter of the minerals

findings.title: Conveying party has no evidenced acquisition
findings.explanation: H. W. Stiles conveyed an undivided 1/8 mineral interest in the subject tract by the instrument recorded 2016-05-30, but no reviewed instrument vests any interest in H. W. Stiles. Admitting the claim would over-allocate the estate and dilute every reconciled holder.
findings.nextAction: Search county records 1962 to 2016 for an instrument vesting minerals in that party, examining the three index-only instruments first.

findings.title: No release located for recorded encumbrance
findings.explanation: The deed of trust recorded 1991-06-14 has no matching release in the records reviewed. This is a statement about the search, not a determination that the lien remains active.
findings.nextAction: Search the county grantor index under the lender for a release, partial release, or satisfaction.

findings.title: Allocation between co-grantees not stated
findings.explanation: The 2004 mineral deed conveys one half of the estate to two grantees without stating each one's share. The position is carried as a single undivided holding; equal shares are not assumed.
findings.nextAction: Obtain the recorded image to check for per-grantee fractions, or locate a later partition instrument.

findings.title: Three instruments known from index only
findings.explanation: Three county index entries fall within the search period but their document text was not obtained. An index entry establishes that a record exists; it does not establish what the instrument conveyed.
findings.nextAction: Order the recorded images for all three and re-run the reconstruction.
